# StudyDoc

> StudyDoc is an AI-powered academic paper reader that transforms complex research PDFs into layered explanations, concept diagrams, quizzes, tutor-style Q&A, and formatted citations.

## What StudyDoc Does

StudyDoc helps students and researchers understand academic papers faster. Upload any PDF — including scanned documents — and StudyDoc generates:

- **Layered explanations** at Beginner, Intermediate, and Expert levels
- **Section-by-section summaries** covering Introduction, Methods, Results, Discussion, and Conclusion
- **Research details** — research question, methodology, data, key results, limitations, and future work
- **Concept diagrams** showing how the paper's ideas connect
- **Tutor Mode** — ask any question about the paper and get an answer grounded in the paper's content
- **Quizzes** for self-testing comprehension
- **Citations** in APA, MLA, Chicago, IEEE, and BibTeX formats with auto-extracted metadata
- **Paper comparison** — side-by-side AI analysis of two papers
- **Personal notes** per paper, synced to your account
- **Semantic search** across your entire saved library

## Who It's For

- Undergraduate and graduate students reading assigned papers
- Researchers doing literature reviews
- Pre-med, STEM, social science, and humanities students
- Anyone who needs to understand academic content quickly

## Pricing

- **Free**: 3 AI-powered PDF uploads per day, saved library, explanations, quizzes
- **Pro**: $8/month — higher upload limits, full Tutor Mode, semantic library search, priority processing
